arabic_title: دُعَاؤُهُ فِي اللَّجَإِ إِلَى اللَّهِ تَعَالَى

phrases.arabic: اللّهُمَّ إن تَشَأْ تعفُ عَنّا فَبِفضْلِكَ ،
phrases.english: 1. O God, if You willest, You wilt pardon us through Your bounty

phrases.arabic: وَانْ تَشَأْ تُعَذِّبْنا فَبَعدْلِكَ. فَسَهِّلْ لَنَا عَفْوَكَ بِمنِّكَ ،
phrases.english: 2. and if You willest, You wilt chastise us through Your justice. So make our ways smooth to Your pardon through Your kindness

phrases.arabic: وَأَجِرْنَا مِنْ عَذَابِكَ بِتَجاوُزكَ; فَإنَّهُ لاَ طاقَةَ لَنَا بَعدلِكَ،
phrases.english: 3. and grant us sanctuary from Your chastisement through Your forbearance, for none of us has the endurance for Your justice

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ نجاةَ لأحَد مِنّا دُوْنَ عَفْوِكَ.
phrases.english: 4. and none of us can reach deliverance without Your pardon!

phrases.arabic: يا غَنِيَّ الأغْنياء هَا نَحَنُ عِبادُكَ بين يدَيكَ
phrases.english: 5. O Richest of the rich! Here we are, Your servants, before You.

phrases.arabic: وَأَنَا أَفقَرُ الفْقَراء إليْكَ فَأجْبُرْ فاقَتَنا بِوُسْعِكَ ،
phrases.english: 6. I am the neediest of the needy toward You, so redress our neediness through Your plenty

phrases.arabic: ولا تَقْطَعَ رَجَاءنا بِمَنْعِكَ فَتَكُوْنَ قد أَشْقَيْتَ مَنِ اسْتَسْعَدَ بِكَ ،
phrases.english: 7. and cut us not off from our hopes through Your withholding, lest You makest wretched him who seeks felicity through You

phrases.arabic: وَجَرَمْتَ مَنِ اسْتَرْفَدَ فَضْلَكَ.
phrases.english: 8. and deprivest him who seeks help from Your bounty!

phrases.arabic: فَإلى مَنْ حيْنئذ مُنْقَلَبُنَا عَنْكَ ،
phrases.english: 9. Then to whom would we return after You?

phrases.arabic: وإلى أيْنَ مَذهَبُنَا عن بَابِكَ ،
phrases.english: 10. Where would we go from Your gate?

phrases.arabic: سُبْحَنَكَ نَحْنُ المضْطُّرون الذّينَ أَوْجَبْتَ إجابَتَهُمْ ،
phrases.english: 11. Glory be to You! We are the distressed, the response to whom You hast made incumbent,

phrases.arabic: وَأهْلُ  السُّوْء الذّيْنَ وَعَدْتَ الْكَشْفَ عَنْهُمْ.
phrases.english: 12. the people from whom You hast promised to remove the evil.

phrases.arabic: وَأَشْبَـهُ الأَشْياءِ بِمَشِيَّتِـكَ ،
phrases.english: 13. That thing most resembling Your will

phrases.arabic: وَأَوْلَى الأمُورِ بِكَ فِيْ عَظَمَتِكَ رَحْمَةُ مَنِ اسْتَرْحَمَكَ،
phrases.english: 14. and that affair most worthy for You in Your mightiness is showing mercy to him who asks You for mercy

phrases.arabic: وَغَوْثُ مَنِ اسْتَغَاثَ بِكَ، فَارْحَمْ تَضَرُّعَنَا إلَيْكَ،
phrases.english: 15. and helping him who seeks help from You. So show mercy upon our pleading with You

phrases.arabic: وَأَغْنِنَا إذْ طَرَحْنَـا أَنْفُسَنَا بَيْنَ يَـدَيْكَ.
phrases.english: 16. and free us from need when we throw ourselves before You!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ إنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ قَدْ شمِتَ بِنَا إذْ شَايَعْنَاهُ عَلَى مَعْصِيَتِكَ،
phrases.english: 17. O God, Satan will gloat over us if we follow him in disobeying You,

phrases.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ
phrases.english: 18. so bless Muhammad and his Household

phrases.arabic: وَلا تُشْمِتْهُ بِنَا بَعْدَ تَرْكِنَا إيَّاهُ لَكَ،
phrases.english: 19. and let him not gloat over us after we have renounced him for You

phrases.arabic: وَرَغْبَتِنَا عَنْهُ إلَيْكَ.
phrases.english: 20. and beseeched You against him!
